SELECT (SELECT fx_market_data_state.history_ready 
FROM fx_market_data_state 
WHERE fx_market_data_state.pair_id = $1::INTEGER) AS anon_1, (SELECT coalesce(sum(fx_candle.gold_volume), $2::NUMERIC) AS coalesce_1 
FROM fx_candle 
WHERE fx_candle.pair_id = $3::INTEGER AND fx_candle.interval = $4::VARCHAR AND fx_candle.bucket_start >= $5::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND fx_candle.bucket_start < $6::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS anon_2, (SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (fx_trade.side = $7::VARCHAR) THEN fx_trade.input_amount ELSE fx_trade.output_amount END), $8::NUMERIC) AS coalesce_3 
FROM fx_trade 
WHERE fx_trade.pair_id = $9::INTEGER AND fx_trade.created_at >= $10::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND fx_trade.created_at < $11::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS anon_3, (SELECT coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (fx_trade.side = $12::VARCHAR) THEN fx_trade.input_amount ELSE fx_trade.output_amount END), $13::NUMERIC) AS coalesce_5 
FROM fx_trade 
WHERE fx_trade.pair_id = $14::INTEGER AND fx_trade.created_at >= $15::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND fx_trade.created_at < $16::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) AS anon_4, (SELECT coalesce(sum(fx_pool_event.gold_volume), $17::NUMERIC) AS coalesce_7 
FROM fx_pool_event 
WHERE fx_pool_event.pair_id = $18::INTEGER AND fx_pool_event.created_at >= $19::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND fx_pool_event.created_at < $20::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND fx_pool_event.id > (SELECT fx_market_data_state.last_event_id 
FROM fx_market_data_state 
WHERE fx_market_data_state.pair_id = $21::INTEGER)) AS anon_5
